rules: No catalog, checkout, analytics, content, customer data, or promotion may cross silo boundaries.
DreamLedger remains neutral and does not become a silo.
Shared infrastructure may be reused only when silo identity is explicit and data isolation is preserved.
Every monetization surface must emit a proof artifact before revenue claims are made.
ACCOUNTING live payments and tax filings require explicit human approval.
PRODUCTION_VERIFICATION may reuse the commerce spine but must retain its own offer, prospect, fulfillment, and economic evidence namespace.
CUBE clones preserve source-silo identity and may not import another silo's customer data, credentials, analytics, content, or promotion.
